preset.inventory_sweeper.classic_junk: Common low-value pickups such as rotten flesh, poisonous potatoes, spider eyes, basic seeds, and dead bushes.
preset.inventory_sweeper.flowers_and_lit: Every item in Minecraft's flowers tag, plus leaf litter.
preset.inventory_sweeper.seeds_and_sapli: Crop seeds, ancient plant seeds, and every sapling.
preset.inventory_sweeper.mining_rubble: Common stone and excavation clutter, including cobblestone, dirt, gravel, tuff, and netherrack.
preset.inventory_sweeper.mob_leftovers: Common hostile-mob drops. Includes useful items such as gunpowder, bones, string, and slime balls; enable carefully.
preset.inventory_sweeper.ocean_clutter: Kelp, seagrass, ink sacs, and common prismarine drops.
config.inventory_sweeper.title: Inventory Sweeper
config.inventory_sweeper.category.visual: Control how items automatically dropped by Inventory Sweeper appear.
config.inventory_sweeper.dropped_item_op: Opacity used only for fresh item entities automatically dropped by Inventory Sweeper. Other ground items and manual drops are unchanged.
config.inventory_sweeper.dropped_item_fa: Time until an auto-dropped item becomes fully opaque. Set to Never to keep the selected opacity.
config.inventory_sweeper.category.preset: Ready-made groups of commonly unwanted items.
config.inventory_sweeper.category.custom: Fine-grained item ID drop and keep rules.
config.inventory_sweeper.category.safety: Protect special item variants from automatic dropping.
config.inventory_sweeper.enabled.tooltip: When enabled, matching items are dropped only when their inventory count increases. Existing items are preserved until /sweeper purge is used.
config.inventory_sweeper.notifications.t: Show Inventory Sweeper status messages above the hotbar.
Show the most recently dropped item and amount. Requires action bar notifications.
config.inventory_sweeper.drop_delay.tool: How long newly acquired matching items wait before being dropped. This gives you time to disable the Sweeper if needed.
config.inventory_sweeper.actions_per_tic: Higher values clear large partial stacks faster but send more inventory actions to a server. One is the safest default.
config.inventory_sweeper.pause_in_screen: Pause While a Screen Is Open
Do not detect or drop items while any menu, chat, inventory, or container screen is open.
config.inventory_sweeper.container_trans: Treat items moved from chests and other containers into your inventory like pickups. The pause-in-screens option takes priority.
config.inventory_sweeper.presets.explana: Presets can be combined. Keep overrides and the safety rules always take priority.
config.inventory_sweeper.custom_rules.ex: Use item IDs such as minecraft:flint. Modded item IDs are supported when their items are registered. Keep overrides always win when an item appears in both lists.
config.inventory_sweeper.custom_drop_ite: Item IDs added here are dropped without requiring a preset.
config.inventory_sweeper.kept_items.tool: Item IDs added here are protected from every preset and the custom drop list.
config.inventory_sweeper.safety.explanat: These protections apply before presets and custom drop rules. They also apply to /sweeper purge.
config.inventory_sweeper.protect_named.t: Never automatically drop an item with a custom name.
config.inventory_sweeper.protect_enchant: Never automatically drop enchanted items or enchanted books.
config.inventory_sweeper.protect_damaged: Never automatically drop a damageable item after it has lost durability.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.inventory_swe: Automatically drops unwanted items as you pick them up.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.inventory: A highly configurable inventory cleaner with presets, per-item rules, safety protections, and precise pickup tracking.
